_comment: assign_pack precedence: see bake_assets.py. Order matters: earlier packs win for path_prefixes. music (lazy) is listed before shared so audio/music/ files route there even though they share the audio/ prefix. scene_main_menu (lazy) is listed before shared/gameplay so textures/scenes/main_menu/ wins over the broader textures/. shared (eager) = cross-scene: fonts/, textures/tile_sets/ (atlases), all other audio/ SFX. gameplay (eager) = bulk 3D/UI: data/, the rest of textures/, steam_assets/, and 3d/ models.
